bank_esr.direction: upper bound at 120 Hz and therefore also at the discharge frequency (ESR falls with frequency)

bank_esr.lower_bound_reason: no minimum or high-frequency ESR is published

fuse_resistance.kind: typical hot, upper bound on cold
fuse_resistance.direction: HOT figure (steady state at 50 A rated); positive temperature coefficient makes the cold onset resistance lower, so it is an upper bound at fault onset
fuse_resistance.source: Mersen A70QS50-14F Watts Loss @ Rated Current = 11.6 W at 50 A; R = P/I^2

u9_healthy_on.direction: at 25 C this bounds the on-resistance; the HOT on-resistance is higher and is NOT published, so this is a lower bound on the hot value and cannot bound the loop R
u9_healthy_on.source: STW65N65DM2AG datasheet Table 5 (VGS=10 V, ID=30 A, Tcase=25 C)

u9_failed_short_residual.reason: no failed-short residual is published; Rds_on is a healthy/on parameter and is not the short residual

u10_failed_short_residual.reason: no failed-short residual is published; the datasheet gives only a forward model (RT = 0.055 ohm/leg at 25 C), which is not a short residual

copper.direction: lower bound at 20 C / nearest cap / least-resistance path; upper at 100 C / farthest cap
copper.source: raw/compute_bounds.py over section.kicad_pcb, >=3 mm power copper, 0.07 mm copper

resistance_decomposition.loop_resistance_upper_bound_reason: unbounded above by sourced data: the two failed-short residuals are unpublished and each could exceed the 0.4466 ohm left below the action screen

copper.model: current sheet L = mu0 * h_eff * length / w_eff
copper.return_path_assumption_lower: return current flows directly beneath the forward path; h = the 1.44 mm single-core dielectric
copper.return_path_assumption_upper: return current is horizontally offset by the measured worst-case separation (34.5 mm); h = 1.44 + 34.5 mm

inductance_decomposition.loop_inductance_upper_bound_note: the copper term is bounded; the unpublished internal inductances add >= 0 and are not bounded, though at component scale they are far below the 25.7 uH break-even for R >= 400L

frequency_caveat.discharge_frequency: ~0.5 kHz to ~300 kHz, from 1/(2*pi*L/R) over the bounded (L,R)
frequency_caveat.esr_basis: tan delta is quoted at 120 Hz; ESR decreases with frequency, so the 120 Hz max is a safe upper bound at the discharge frequency
frequency_caveat.copper_basis: skin depth at 100 kHz = 0.209 mm > 0.07 mm copper, so the DC copper resistance is a lower bound on AC copper resistance; proximity/edge effects over 8 mm traces are not modelled
frequency_caveat.dc_is_a_bound_in_the_safe_direction: yes for the upper-bound use: DC/tan-delta figures overestimate the bank ESR and underestimate the copper AC resistance, and both directions are stated per term

single_most_important_missing_input: The failed-short residual resistance of U9 (STW65N65DM2AG) and U10 (C3D20065D). It is the only term that can move the loop R across the 0.64013 ohm action screen, and no datasheet publishes it. A high-current pulse measurement (or a supplier/qualification shock-test record) of the shorted-device residual would close the upper bound and turn the INDETERMINATE verdict into inside or outside. Paired second: the bank's minimum/high-frequency ESR, which is needed to close the R >= 400L boundary.
